name: A name on the street
description: Complete three successful jobs. Mara needs to know your word carries weight.

name: People you can trust
description: Recruit two crew members. A future this ambitious needs people beside you.

name: Beyond the Quarter
description: Reach 100 reputation and earn an introduction to Portside.

name: A piece of the city
description: Own your first business. Lasting power needs a daily foundation.

name: An invitation upstairs
description: Reach 200 reputation. Ivo has reserved a place among the Strip's decision makers.

name: Weight behind your word
description: Build 50 influence. Lin wants proof that your promises can shape the city.

name: The skyline listens
description: Reach 550 reputation. Selene is ready to discuss the Meridian reserve.

name: A seat at the top
description: Complete the Meridian heist. Decide what the city will remember about your rise.

name: Still standing
description: Reach your third day in the city. Patience is a skill worth learning.

name: Sharpen your judgment
description: Complete three training sessions. Preparation earns its own reward.

name: Tools of the trade
description: Own three permanent items. Build a kit that suits the life you chose.

name: A quieter name
description: Keep heat at 20 or below. Vale appreciates a city that can breathe.

name: Reliable company
description: Complete ten successful jobs. Reliability travels farther than a rumor.

name: A rainy-day account
description: Hold $15,000 in cash. Ambition works better with a reserve.

name: A proper crew
description: Recruit four crew members. Different talents make room for bigger plans.

name: Three steady doors
description: Own three businesses. Give the city reasons to keep you here.

name: A wider map
description: Visit three districts. Every neighborhood teaches a different lesson.

name: A voice that matters
description: Reach 75 influence. The city should hear more than a demand from you.

name: Thirty nights
description: Reach day 30. An empire is measured by what survives.

name: A citywide reputation
description: Reach 800 reputation. Let every district know the person behind the name.
